user.title: Just-In-Time Freebox
user.description: Configure the grants API and your local Freebox host. After submitting, you will be asked to press the right arrow on the Freebox front panel to authorize this integration.

pairing.title: Authorize on Freebox
pairing.description: Press the right arrow (▶) on the Freebox front panel to authorize Home Assistant, then submit. This step will wait for confirmation from the Freebox.

error.grants_api_error: Could not reach the grants API with the provided URL/key.
error.freebox_discovery_error: Could not discover the Freebox API at this host.
error.freebox_connection_error: Could not connect to the Freebox.
error.pairing_denied: Pairing was denied on the Freebox.
